    X_train_flat, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# one-hot encoding
y_train_split_onehot = to_categorical(y_train_split)
y_val_split_onehot = to_categorical(y_val_split)
y_train_onehot = to_categorical(y_train)
y_test_onehot = to_categorical(y_test)
In [14]:
# Initialize the base model
def create_mlp_model(hidden_layers=2, neurons=128, dropout_rate=0.2, learning_rate=0.001):
    input_dim = X_train_flat.shape[1]
    num_classes = len(np.unique(y_train))

    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Dense(neurons, activation='relu', input_shape=(input_dim,)))
    model.add(Dropout(dropout_rate))

    for _ in range(hidden_layers - 1):
        model.add(Dense(neurons, activation='relu'))
        model.add(Dropout(dropout_rate))

    model.add(Dense(num_classes, activation='softmax'))

    model.compile(
        loss='categorical_crossentropy',
        optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=learning_rate),
        metrics=['accuracy']
    )

    return model

2.3 Convolutional neural network¶

In [8]:
from tensorflow.keras.layers import Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, Dense, Dropout

# Build CNN model
cnn_model = Sequential([
    Conv2D(32, kernel_size=(3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(28, 28, 3)),
    MaxPooling2D(pool_size=(2, 2)),
    Conv2D(64, kernel_size=(3, 3), activation='relu'),
    MaxPooling2D(pool_size=(2, 2)),
    Flatten(),
    Dense(64, activation='relu'),
    Dropout(0.5),
    Dense(y_train_onehot.shape[1], activation='softmax')
])

# Compile the CNN model
cnn_model.compile(optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=0.001),
                  loss='categorical_crossentropy',
                  metrics=['accuracy'])

# Train the CNN model
cnn_model.fit(X_train, y_train_onehot,
              epochs=10, batch_size=128,
              validation_split=0.2)

# Evaluate model on the test set
loss_cnn, accuracy_cnn = cnn_model.evaluate(X_test, y_test_onehot)
print(f"CNN test accuracy: {accuracy_cnn:.4f}")

3.2 Fully connected neural network¶

In [ ]:
# Define hyperparameter search space
param_grid = {
    'hidden_layers': [2],
    'neurons': [256, 512],
    'dropout_rate': [0.2, 0.3],
    'learning_rate': [0.00005, 0.0001,0.001]
}

# earlystopping
early_stopping = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=10, restore_best_weights=True)

# Grid search results
results = []
best_val_acc = 0
best_params = {}

total_combinations = (len(param_grid['hidden_layers']) *
                     len(param_grid['neurons']) *
                     len(param_grid['dropout_rate']) *
                     len(param_grid['learning_rate']))

start_time = time.time()
print(f"Beginning grid search...total of {total_combinations} combinations")
current_combination = 0

# Instantiate and train the model
for hidden_layers in param_grid['hidden_layers']:
    for neurons in param_grid['neurons']:
        for dropout_rate in param_grid['dropout_rate']:
            for learning_rate in param_grid['learning_rate']:
                current_combination += 1

                print(f"\ncombination {current_combination}/{total_combinations} ({current_combination/total_combinations*100:.1f}%)")
                print(f"hidden_layers={hidden_layers}, neurons={neurons}, Dropout={dropout_rate}, learning_rate={learning_rate}")

                model = create_mlp_model(
                    hidden_layers=hidden_layers,
                    neurons=neurons,
                    dropout_rate=dropout_rate,
                    learning_rate=learning_rate
                )

                history = model.fit(
                    X_train_split, y_train_split_onehot,
                    epochs=100, # Additional epochs to ensure convergence
                    batch_size=128,
                    validation_data=(X_val_split, y_val_split_onehot),
                    callbacks=[early_stopping],
                    verbose=1
                )

                # Extract best validation accuracy
                val_acc = max(history.history['val_accuracy'])

                print(f"val_acc: {val_acc:.4f}, Training epochs: {len(history.history['val_accuracy'])}")

                results.append({
                    'hidden_layers': hidden_layers,
                    'neurons': neurons,
                    'dropout_rate': dropout_rate,
                    'learning_rate': learning_rate,
                    'val_accuracy': val_acc
                })

                # Update parameters
                if val_acc > best_val_acc:
                    best_val_acc = val_acc
                    best_params = {
                        'hidden_layers': hidden_layers,
                        'neurons': neurons,
                        'dropout_rate': dropout_rate,
                        'learning_rate': learning_rate
                    }
                    print(f"new combination: {best_val_acc:.4f}")

elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\nelapsed_time: {elapsed_time:.2f}s")
print(f"best_params: {best_params}")
print(f"best_val_acc: {best_val_acc:.4f}")

# Best 5 results
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values('val_accuracy', ascending=False)
print("\n:Besst 5 results: ")
print(results_df.head())

# Function to build, train, evaluate, and plot results for CNN models
def build_and_train_cnn_with_plot(filters=32, dropout=0.5, lr=0.001, idx=0, verbose=True):
    # Define CNN architecture
    model = Sequential([
        Conv2D(filters, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(28, 28, 3)),
        MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
        Conv2D(filters * 2, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
        MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
        Flatten(),
        Dense(64, activation='relu'),
        Dropout(dropout),
        Dense(y_train_onehot.shape[1], activation='softmax')
    ])

    # Compile CNN model
    model.compile(optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=lr),
                  loss='categorical_crossentropy',
                  metrics=['accuracy'])

    # Train the CNN model with validation split
    history = model.fit(X_train, y_train_onehot,
                        validation_split=0.2,
                        epochs=20,
                        batch_size=128,
                        verbose=1 if verbose else 0)

    # Evaluate model performance on the test set
    test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test_onehot, verbose=0)
    y_pred_probs = model.predict(X_test, verbose=0)
    y_pred_labels = np.argmax(y_pred_probs, axis=1)
    y_true_labels = np.argmax(y_test_onehot, axis=1)

    # Calculate F1 scores
    f1_macro = f1_score(y_true_labels, y_pred_labels, average='macro')
    f1_weighted = f1_score(y_true_labels, y_pred_labels, average='weighted') 
 # Plot training vs. validation accuracy and loss
    acc = history.history['accuracy']
    val_acc = history.history['val_accuracy']
    loss = history.history['loss']
    val_loss = history.history['val_loss']
    epochs = range(1, len(acc) + 1)

    plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

    plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
    plt.plot(epochs, acc, 'bo-', label='Training Accuracy')
    plt.plot(epochs, val_acc, 'ro-', label='Validation Accuracy')
    plt.title(f'Accuracy (F1-macro: {f1_macro:.4f})')
    plt.xlabel('Epoch')
    plt.ylabel('Accuracy')
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True)

    plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
    plt.plot(epochs, loss, 'bo-', label='Training Loss')
    plt.plot(epochs, val_loss, 'ro-', label='Validation Loss')
    plt.title('Loss')
    plt.xlabel('Epoch')
    plt.ylabel('Loss')
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # Display detailed metrics if verbose is enabled
    if verbose:
        print(f"→ Test Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}, F1-macro: {f1_macro:.4f}, F1-weighted: {f1_weighted:.4f}")
        print("\nClassification Report:\n", classification_report(y_true_labels, y_pred_labels))

    return test_acc, f1_macro, f1_weighted, model

# Evaluate multiple CNN configurations and plot results
cnn_results = []
cnn_configs = [
    (32, 0.3, 0.001),
    (64, 0.5, 0.001),
    (64, 0.3, 0.0005),
    (128, 0.5, 0.0005)
]

for idx, cfg in enumerate(cnn_configs):
    acc, f1_mac, f1_wt, _ = build_and_train_cnn_with_plot(*cfg, idx=idx)
    cnn_results.append((cfg, acc, f1_mac, f1_wt))
# Summarize results for all tested CNN configurations
print("\n=== Summary of CNN Results ===")

4. Final models¶

In this section, please ensure to include cells to train each model with its best hyperparmater combination independently of the hyperparameter tuning cells, i.e. don't rely on the hyperparameter tuning cells having been run.

4.1 Random forest¶

In [47]:
final_rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    max_depth=30,
    n_estimators=200,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    max_features='sqrt',
    random_state=42
)

final_rf_model.fit(X_train_flat, y_train)

y_pred_final_rf = final_rf_model.predict(X_test_flat)

accuracy_final = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_final_rf)
print(f"Final Random Forest Accuracy: {accuracy_final:.4f}")

print("Final Random Forest Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred_final_rf))

4.2 Fully connected neural network¶

In [ ]:
# Construct final model with best hyperparameters
final_mlp_model = create_mlp_model(
    hidden_layers=best_params['hidden_layers'],
    neurons=best_params['neurons'],
    dropout_rate=best_params['dropout_rate'],
    learning_rate=best_params['learning_rate']
)

early_stopping = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=10, restore_best_weights=True)
history = final_mlp_model.fit(
    X_train_flat, y_train_onehot,
    epochs=120,
    batch_size=128,
    validation_split=0.2,
    callbacks=[early_stopping],
    verbose=1
)

test_loss, test_accuracy = final_mlp_model.evaluate(X_test_flat, y_test_onehot)
print(f"test_accuracy: {test_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions and reports
y_pred_probs = final_mlp_model.predict(X_test_flat)
y_pred_mlp = np.argmax(y_pred_probs, axis=1)
print("MLPclassification_report:")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred_mlp, digits=4))

# 1. Plot learning curves (accuracy and loss)
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.plot(history.history['accuracy'], label='Training Accuracy')
plt.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'], label='Validation Accuracy')
plt.title('Model Accuracy')
plt.xlabel('Epoch')
plt.ylabel('Accuracy')
plt.legend()

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Training Loss')
plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Validation Loss')
plt.title('Model Loss')
plt.xlabel('Epoch')
plt.ylabel('Loss')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# F1 scores
f1_per_class = f1_score(y_test, y_pred_mlp, average=None)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
classes = np.unique(y_test)
plt.bar(classes, f1_per_class)
plt.title('F1 Score per Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('F1 Score')
plt.xticks(classes)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.show()


# top 5 hyperparameter combinations
top_results = results_df.head(5)
labels = [f"L{r['hidden_layers']}_N{r['neurons']}_D{r['dropout_rate']}_LR{r['learning_rate']}"
          for _, r in top_results.iterrows()]
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.bar(range(len(labels)), top_results['val_accuracy'])
plt.title('Top 5 Hyperparameter Configurations')
plt.xlabel('Configuration (Layers_Neurons_Dropout_LearningRate)')
plt.ylabel('Validation Accuracy')
plt.xticks(range(len(labels)), labels, rotation=45)
plt.ylim(0.5, 0.7)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

4.3 Convolutional neural network¶

In [ ]:
# Final CNN model with best configuration
final_cnn = Sequential([
    Conv2D(32, (3,3), activation='relu', input_shape=(28, 28, 3)),
    MaxPooling2D((2,2)),
    Conv2D(64, (3,3), activation='relu'),
    MaxPooling2D((2,2)),
    Flatten(),
    Dense(64, activation='relu'),
    Dropout(0.3),
    Dense(y_train_onehot.shape[1], activation='softmax')
])

final_cnn.compile(optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=0.001),
                  loss='categorical_crossentropy',
                  metrics=['accuracy'])

final_cnn.fit(X_train, y_train_onehot,
              epochs=20,
              batch_size=128,
              validation_split=0.2)

# Evaluate
loss_cnn, acc_cnn = final_cnn.evaluate(X_test, y_test_onehot)
print(f"Final CNN Test Accuracy: {acc_cnn:.4f}")
